test_title: PYST 12: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 22 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: A person lent certain sum of money at the annual rate of 24 percent on simple interest. In 5 years the interest amounted to Rs. 1200 more than the sum lent. What is the sum lent?
solution:
**Given:**

A person lent a certain sum of money at the annual rate of 24% on simple interest. In 5 years the interest amounted to ₹1200 more than the sum lent.

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = P × R × T / 100

Where, SI = Interest, P = Principal, R = Rate, T = Time
